tools.name: report_false_positive
tools.description: Report an xgrep finding you are confident is a false positive as an issue on github.com/mondoohq/secure-stack (public), so the rule can be fixed. Provide a MINIMAL, SELF-CONTAINED snippet written for the report that still triggers the rule — never paste the user's own code, names, paths, or secrets. The snippet is checked with xgrep first; the user then sees the exact issue and decides whether to file it.
